title: Validity of input sources
statement: Let $W$ be a natural number, let $t_0,p_0,p_1,p_{-1}$ be Boolean values, let $ho$ assign a natural number to each of eleven registers, and let $ho_Q,ho_I,ho_{LB},ho_{PA},ho_Z$ denote its values at registers $r_Q,r_I,r_{LB},r_{PA},r_Z$. A source is valid when it is a constant, when it is a zero-input source and $ho_{PA}<ho_Z$, when it is a previous-cell source with offset $d\in\{0,1,2\}$ and $1\leq\rho_Q+d$, when it is a current-cell source and $1\leq\rho_I$, or when it is a past-position source and $1\leq\rho_{LB}$. Suppose $1\leq\rho_Q$ whenever $t_0$ and $p_0$ are both false, $1\leq\rho_I$ whenever $p_0$ is false, and $1\leq\rho_{LB}$ whenever $t_0$ is false. If the layer source for a chosen layer in $\{0,1,2\}$ is valid, then every source in the input list—whose entries include the specified constant and layer sources, conditional previous-cell and current-cell sources, and $W$ past-position sources—is valid.
hypotheses_covered: Validity of the source for the chosen layer in $[1m\{0,1,2\}[0m$
